Description: Identify college document types, user query categories, and system functional constraints.
Gather 5 standard college policy PDFs (regulations, exams, handbook, placements, rules).
Formulate 50 benchmark questions divided into Direct (A), Paraphrased (B), and Unanswerable (C).
Download and configure local Ollama daemon for Windows/Linux.
Pull and verify llama3.2:3b and nomic-embed-text models.
Extract text and metadata page-by-page using PyPDF without crashing on blank pages.
Implement sliding-window chunking (1200 chars, 200 overlap) with boundary retention.
Connect nomic-embed-text via Ollama API with fast fallback embedding support.
Initialize ChromaDB persistent collection and implement upsert batching.
Convert user queries to embeddings and query top-k similar chunks from ChromaDB.
Inject formatted document passages into prompt and call local LLM for generation.
Craft strict zero-hallucination prompt instructing model to use only provided context.
Extract document name and page number from chunk metadata and attach to final answer.
Shield system against out-of-scope queries by outputting official refusal message.
Design intuitive 5-tab web dashboard for Q&A, document upload, evaluation, and Jira.
Show collapsible retrieved chunks with similarity scores and page numbers in UI.
Execute end-to-end integration tests on PDF upload, chunking, and Q&A flow.
Execute 50-question benchmark and compute Retrieval Accuracy and Safe Refusal Rate.
Resolve keyword overlap false positives in out-of-scope query detector.
Compile project synopsis, architecture diagrams, slides, and final presentation.
